CBT skills help you notice links among situations, interpretations, emotions, body sensations, and actions, then develop more useful ways to respond.

## Objectives {#objectives}

1. Learn to identify and change unhelpful thought patterns.
2. Take control of interpretations when managing situations in your environment.
3. Develop an action plan to manage unhelpful thought patterns.

{{< include _lesson-catalogue.html >}}

## Put skills into practice

Use the [Thought Record](/tool-finder/thought-record/), [Behavioural Activation planner](/tool-finder/behavioural-activation/), and [Gratitude Journal](/tool-finder/gratitude-journal/) alongside these lessons. The later lessons add original summaries informed by Greenberger and Padesky's *Mind Over Mood*, second edition, with chapter and page references.

For acceptance, defusion, and values-guided action, visit [ACT Skills](/learn/act/).
